thread:
jess_support: FYI customer reporting a burst of 429s on the embeddings endpoint while running a nightly bulk job. they also saw occasional 'dimension mismatch' errors in the same run.
liam_oncall: ok — can you paste a minimal repro and any rate-limit headers from the failures? which model/version are they hitting?
jess_support: here's the simplified call they used (python requests):
```python
resp = requests.post(
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings',
  json={
    'model':'embed-legacy-1536',
    'inputs': big_list_of_texts  # ~12k texts
  },
  headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer sk-cust-XXXXX'}
)
```
they split into 500-item batches, concurrent workers = 8. errors: mostly 429 with Retry-After=1, sometimes 400 with "dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 768"
ops_bot: rate-limit snapshot for key sk-cust-XXXXX: X-RateLimit-Limit: 600/min, X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0, X-RateLimit-Reset: 1670001234
maria_ml: dimension mismatch usually means mixed-model payloads or a preprocessing step returned cached embeddings of wrong length. are they sure all requests use the same model string? also check if any code path does a different embed model for short docs.
ajay_billing: I pulled the account — plan was recently downgraded last week and a quota change applied. I set a temporary throttle on high-concurrency jobs pending payment confirmation. that could explain the remaining=0 and 429s.
liam_oncall: that fits. two concurrent problems: 1) billing-enforced throttles causing sustained 429s, 2) intermittent 400s from dimension mismatch. Recommend isolating them: try a single small run with batch_size=16, concurrency=1, and confirm no 400s. if 429s still happen, it's quota/billing.
jess_support: customer ran with batch=16, concurrency=1: no 400s, but still occasional 429s every ~200 requests. they shared one fail header: Retry-After: 2
maria_ml: intermittent 429 after reducing batch suggests account-level rate cap. dimension mismatch disappeared with small batches?
jess_support: yes dimension errors stopped when they forced model param to 'embed-legacy-1536' per request. earlier they were reading model from env var and had a fallback to 'embed-mini-768' in one worker. that explains the 768 vectors.
liam_oncall: action items: 1) ask billing to remove temporary throttle or request quota bump (ajay). 2) in prod, enforce model name per job to avoid mixed batches (jess). 3) implement client-side exponential backoff + jitter and cap concurrency — sample pseudo: 
```text
for attempt in range(6):
  try request
  except 429: sleep(random.uniform(0, (2 ** attempt) * 0.1))
```
also recommend max batch size 128 for this model when concurrency>4.
ajay_billing: I've queued a quota bump and cleared the temporary throttle; customer should see limits increase in ~15m. also sent link to billing portal to confirm payment method.
jess_support: I'll relay to customer and ask them to rerun the small test after 15m. any suggestions for logs I should capture if errors persist?
liam_oncall: ask for: the full failing request payload (one example), response body, all rate-limit headers, and the worker's model env var at time of request. if they can, a short flamegraph of latency or a histogram of 429 timestamps helps.
jess_support: customer sent a failing payload and the response body, included above. they'll try again in 20m and report back. thanks all :thumbsup:
ops_bot: note — support ticket #SUP-8421 created for quota bump followup.
jess_support: closing loop: after quota bump and fixing the mixed-model bug on their side, they report stable runs with batch=256, concurrency=6 and zero 429s overnight. leaving ticket in monitor for 24h before marking resolved.
liam_oncall: great, recommend a short postmortem: root causes = (1) account-level throttle from billing action, (2) mixed-model batches causing dimension errors, (3) client concurrency+batches overwhelmed quota. mitigation: quota bump, enforce model param per job, client-side backoff + batch sizing guidance.
maria_ml: add note to docs: "Do not mix embedding models in a single batch — ensure consistent model parameter per request."
ajay_billing: logged final billing confirmation. thanks team.
jess_support: thanks everyone, closing thread once 24h clear.
